deploy-bot: Deploy started — PROD · us-east-1 · change-window 23:00-01:00 UTC
deploy-bot: Commits in this release:
• 0a1b2c3 (author: @alice) — PR #4821 https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821
• 7d8e9f0 (author: @ben) — PR #4819 https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4819
• 3c4d5e6 (author: @alice) — PR #4820 https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4820
deploy-bot: Release tag: release-2026-03-20-prod · dry-run:false · config: runtime=v2.1.3, gpu-profile=amp
alice: Pinning runtime image to `redwood/runtime:v2.1.3` for this rollout. Leaving canary at 10%.
ben: Noted. Canaries healthy on first checks, starting traffic ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary results (10 -> 30%): 10m checks: latency p95 220ms, errors 0.3% — within SLOs.
ben: Jumping to 50% now.
dana: Alerting: saw a spike in 504s for /v1/generate in canary pods at 50% — sample logs: 
```
E 03-20 23:12:44 handler.go:142 request_id=abcd1234 upstream=timeout
```
ben: Confirming, observed retries from client side. Error rate trending to 1.5% on canary.
alice: :warning: That crosses our canary abort threshold (>=1%). Reverting to pinned tag v2.1.2 per rollback policy.
frank: Please post rollback plan and update release notes. We need to notify SRE and CS.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @alice — target: tag release-2026-03-05-prod (runtime v2.1.2)
deploy-bot: Commits being reverted:
• revert 0a1b2c3 — reverts PR #4821
• revert 7d8e9f0 — reverts PR #4819
deploy-bot: Running rollout undo:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-prod --to-revision=20260305
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-prod
```
deploy-bot: Rollback complete — all pods on runtime v2.1.2 · time: 23:18 UTC
dana: Confirmed metrics back to baseline, p95 180ms, errors 0.1%.
ben: Opening follow-up PR to instrument longer KV cache TTL in the hot-path. Linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4824
frank: I'll update the release notes and incident stub: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incidents/2026-03-20-canary-504s
alice: Thanks everyone. We'll run smaller canary with extra tracing after the fix. :thumbsup:
